name: font-viewer-vscode
displayName: Font Viewer & Font Preview (TTF, OTF, WOFF)
description: Open TTF, OTF, WOFF, WOFF2 and TTC fonts in VS Code. See every glyph, test sample text with variable axes and OpenType features, and read the license.

fontViewer.sampleText.default: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. 0123456789
fontViewer.sampleText.description: Text shown in the type tester and the waterfall when you open a font. You can edit it in the viewer too.

fontViewer.previewSize.description: Starting size in pixels of the large sample text.

fontViewer.maxFileMB.description: Largest font file, in MB, that Font Viewer opens. Larger files show a message instead, so VS Code stays responsive.

fontViewer.askForRating.description: Ask one time for a Marketplace rating after you have used Font Viewer for a few days. You can answer "Later" or "Don't ask again". Nothing is sent anywhere.

fontViewer.showSupportLinks.description: Show the small Sponsor and More free viewers links in the status line of the font view. The change shows in fonts you open next. Nothing is sent anywhere.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Font Viewer
walkthroughs.description: See the glyphs, test text and read the license of any font file.

steps.title: Open a font
steps.description:
Click a .ttf, .otf, .woff, .woff2 or .ttc file in the Explorer. It opens in the type tester with your sample text and a waterfall of sizes.
[Find a font](command:workbench.action.quickOpen?%5B%22.ttf%22%5D)

media.altText: A variable font in Font Viewer with sample text, a waterfall, a weight slider and OpenType feature toggles.

steps.title: Browse and copy glyphs
steps.description: The Glyphs tab shows every glyph, also the ones with no character, like ligatures and alternates. Search by name, character or U+ code point, then copy the character, the code point or the SVG.

steps.title: Try axes and features
steps.description: Move the variable axis sliders and turn OpenType features such as liga, kern or ss01 on and off. Copy CSS gives you the matching font-variation-settings and font-feature-settings.

steps.title: Check the license and copy @font-face
steps.description:
The Info tab shows the license, designer, embedding rights and metrics, and a ready @font-face rule with font-weight range and unicode-range.
[Open settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22fontViewer%22%5D)

scripts.package: npm run build && npx -y @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies -o dist/
